capabilities: Sync vault files two-way with a WebDAV server
Archive deleted files in an append-only trash backup
Back up encrypted plugin configs and API keys
Resolve conflicts by keeping both versions
Filter sync with glob ignore rules and optional .obsidian sync
extras: The WebDAV password is stored in plain text in the plugin's own data.json, which is always excluded from sync. No cross-device lock is implemented, so avoid editing the same file on two devices. Desktop only; mobile support is unverified.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault to a self-hosted WebDAV server, and deleted files can vanish when the server copy is removed.

relations.evidence: synchronizes your Obsidian vault with any standard WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud, SFTPGo, Apache mod_dav, nginx-dav, …)

summary: Two-way WebDAV sync plugin with an append-only trash archive and encrypted backup of plugin configs and API keys.
